title: Marginal Cost Analysis in Economics
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A company's cost to produce x units is C(x) = 2000 + 10x + 0.1x^2 dollars. Find the marginal cost function C'(x), evaluate it at x = 100, and compare with the actual cost of the 101st unit.

steps.title: Compute Marginal Cost Function
steps.why: Marginal cost is defined as the derivative of total cost.

steps.title: Evaluate at Production Level x = 100
steps.why: Estimates the marginal cost of producing the 101st item.

steps.title: Calculate Exact Cost of 101st Unit
steps.why: Demonstrates that marginal cost ($30) closely approximates discrete incremental cost ($30.10).
